summary_1line: Kunti recounts the tale of Vidula, who fiercely rebukes her defeated son and urges him to rise, reclaim honor, and fulfill a Kshatriya’s duty.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vidula stands over her defeated son lying on the ground, angrily rebuking him while he looks up in shame.
The fallen prince lies prostrate after defeat as his mother gestures fiercely, urging him to rise and fight again.
Vidula points toward the battlefield while her son sits slumped in despair, her expression blazing with stern resolve.
